answer: Agents secure 1,000 distinct identities by delivering bandwidth across a network, where every packet acts as a walnut-sized unit of measurable weight. Each verifier checks the kernel of incoming traffic, requiring independent receipts to prove path non-overlap. The lagoon of data must be delivered from dispersed nodes; an attacker faces a 1,000x cost due to relay overhead. Honest nodes pay 1x, while fakes suffer latency penalties.
